cards.name: Value price · Strawberry · Water-based
cards.effect_basis: Estimated sustained change in requested/forecast ratio from baseline to recent, after shrinkage; not the raw recent requested-minus-forecast percentage.
cards.series_scope: Observed requests and current-model expectations for eligible SKU/district units; SKU promotion days excluded. Observed chart values are not winsorised.
cards.pallet_change_basis: Footprint of the change in total purchased cases; not a change in simultaneous warehouse peak occupancy.
cards.peak_capacity_scope: Whole warehouse with ALL cohort adjustments and current overrides already included together.

leaf.series_scope: Observed requests and current-model expectations for eligible SKU/district units; SKU promotion days excluded. Observed chart values are not winsorised.

trace.tree: inverse-variance conditional inference; max depth 3; min 3 distinct SKUs per child
trace.permutation_scheme: product tags: whole SKU district vectors within equal-support strata; district tags: districts within each SKU; y and v paired; max across all candidates
trace.sku_covariance: district demand weights; conditional variances independent; shared leaf posterior covariance
trace.unit_definition: SKU × district; complete observed and issued rows; at least one eligible day in each window
trace.winsorisation: per store/SKU 99th percentile across eligible 70-day history before aggregation
trace.overdispersion: sample variance of seven-day (A-E)/sqrt(E) baseline residuals, floored at 1
trace.forecast_error_variance: Per SKU/district, sample variance of eligible baseline seven-day log((A+0.5)/(E+0.5)) current-model residuals minus mean 1/(E+0.5) count-sampling variance, clipped at zero; log-rate units squared. Add this weekly systematic variance times (7/recent eligible days + 1/baseline eligible weeks) to each unit log-change variance. Uses historical issued weather and baseline outcomes only; part of the baseline may be in the current model training period. No percentage floor.
trace.drilldown_effect: Inverse-variance weighted mean unit log change transformed with expm1 × 100 at each actual tree prefix, before leaf and SKU shrinkage. Daily requests are raw eligible observations; siblings are within the same parent.

method.order_impact_scope: SKU order differences allocated by each leaf district forecast share; case total rounded. Disjoint district leaves do not duplicate total value.
method.value_method: Normal expected shortage difference under the adjusted demand distribution
